product_contract.shared: A pressure runner is trustworthy when its exit status, workload result, clock, process identity, retained artifacts, and summary describe the same attempt without depending on unrelated local signing state.
product_contract.tab_switch: The local tab-switch stress app build is unsigned because the workload does not consume a permission-bearing app identity.
product_contract.search: Every retained Search sample uses one system-wide monotonic epoch; active duration is the sum of valid positive adjacent deltas under the declared cadence.
product_contract.runtime_topology: Sampling binds one unique post-request app identity after it remains eligible for a declared stability window, excludes transient permission probes, retains a one-to-one PID binding for every sample, and accepts a UI result bundle only when Info.plist is present.
product_contract.terminal_ui_result: When XCTest terminates the sampled App during teardown, the runner gives the UI wrapper a bounded completion window, preserves the complete result bundle, and propagates the UI wrapper outcome.

production_path: A canonical pressure entry point resolves repository-relative build and evidence path intent.
The runner builds or invokes its workload through the repository testing wrappers.
The workload process and sampling clock produce raw attempt-specific evidence.
Runtime topology additionally qualifies a stable fixed-App identity and verifies it before each sample.
Evidence tooling validates raw samples, child status, identity receipts, and artifact completeness.
The top-level status and exit code classify runner failure, workload success, or a downstream product failure.

independent_oracle: The tab-switch xcodebuild log records CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO and the app exits zero with nonempty samples.
Fresh helper invocations are strictly increasing and each Search summary proves at least 30 active seconds, conformant cadence, and successful child batches.
The runtime launch receipt proves a stable unique post-request identity and records transient-candidate rejection.
Every runtime PID-binding row matches one sample and the frozen App identity.
A complete UI result bundle contains Info.plist and the top-level runner propagates the UI wrapper result.

test_quality_conclusion.fixture_fidelity: The Search attempts execute the production FlowTabTests workload matrix, and runtime topology executes the existing signed fixed-App Noisy Option+Tab scenario with real macOS processes and Spaces.
test_quality_conclusion.async_waiting: Sampling polls live process state. Runtime target qualification requires 5 seconds of stable identity, and terminal App loss grants a bounded 30-second XCTest finalization window.
test_quality_conclusion.timeout: Target discovery is bounded to 45 seconds, terminal finalization is bounded to 30 seconds, workload wrappers retain their existing termination controls, and no unbounded runner wait was added.
test_quality_conclusion.cleanup: Runner exit traps terminate and reap child process trees; normal XCTest teardown is allowed to finish before cleanup.
test_quality_conclusion.isolation: Every attempt uses a unique evidence leaf; private fixed-App identity remains outside committed source.
test_quality_conclusion.mock_boundaries: The runner contract is validated through real shell, xcodebuild, XCTest, process, clock, and result-bundle boundaries.
test_quality_conclusion.flake_assessment: Clock comparisons use a system-wide POSIX monotonic epoch, runtime binding requires repeated stable observations, and all summaries reject missing samples or nonconformant identity/cadence evidence.
test_quality_conclusion.target_reachability: All three entry points passed help and syntax checks and were reached by their canonical attempts.

tab_switch.c0_observation: The 20ms workload stopped at xcodebuild exit 65 before sampling because the runner requested a locally signed Debug app.

search_clock.c0_observation: Fresh Python processes returned process-relative monotonic values, collapsing 72 and 91 samples to 0.036 and 0.033 active seconds.

runtime_identity.c0_observation: The runner bound the first matching post-request process, a permission probe terminated after 4.22 seconds, then classified identity_match_lost and killed the UI child.

root_cause.tab_switch: The standalone xcodebuild invocation omitted the repository unsigned local-build setting, coupling a non-permission workload to historical signing state.
root_cause.search_clock: Each sample launched a fresh system Python process whose monotonic epoch is process-relative on this machine, so adjacent timestamps were not comparable.
root_cause.runtime_identity: The launch Oracle accepted the first unique identity without a stability interval and therefore selected the short-lived permission probe.
root_cause.runtime_result: The runner recorded a failed binding row before a sample and terminated the UI wrapper as soon as XCTest tore down the App; result-bundle presence checked only the directory and could accept an incomplete staging bundle.

semantic_delta.tab_switch: The stress app build explicitly disables code signing.
semantic_delta.search: Sampling and loop duration use one shared POSIX monotonic-clock helper across fresh invocations.
semantic_delta.runtime_topology: Identity policy v2 requires a unique candidate to remain stable for 5 seconds, rejects transient candidates, and records qualification evidence in a versioned launch receipt.
semantic_delta.runtime_sampling: Identity probes become binding rows only when a sample is retained, preserving a one-to-one contract.
semantic_delta.runtime_termination: Target disappearance during XCTest teardown grants a bounded wrapper-completion window and preserves the final UI outcome and complete xcresult.
semantic_delta.structure: Runtime target discovery and sampling move into a focused helper, reducing the main runner to a single orchestration responsibility.
